source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of sorting algorithms (PDF 83).

blocks.text: Sorting algorithms data ko kisi khaas tarteeb mein lagate hain, jaise ascending (chhote se bara) ya descending (bare se chhota). Sorting ek bunyadi amal hai jo aksar doosre kaamon, jaise searching aur data analysis, ki pehli shart (prerequisite) hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Searching se pehle aksar sorting kyun ki jati hai?
blocks.explanation: Kyun ke Binary Search jaise tez tareeqe sirf tarteeb wale (sorted) data par chalte hain.

items: Sorting data ko tarteeb deti hai aur searching aur analysis ke liye tayyar karti hai.
